en-US.title: Zode for ZCode
en-US.subtitle: Phone companion for ZCode
en-US.promoText: Use ZCode from your phone. Zode connects to ZCode on your Mac through a free relay: follow sessions, read the work, start new ones.
en-US.description:
Zode is a companion app for ZCode, the AI coding app. It lets you follow and control your ZCode coding sessions from your phone. Your Mac stays the host: it runs ZCode and a small free relay that bridges your phone to ZCode.

WHAT YOU NEED
1. ZCode installed on a Mac.
2. The free, open-source Zode relay running on that same Mac (set up with one command: https://github.com/zrll2/zode).
3. This app on your phone.

HOW IT CONNECTS
Phone  ->  Zode relay on your Mac  ->  ZCode
You pair your phone once by scanning a QR code that the relay shows on your Mac. After that, Zode reaches your Mac over your home network, or over a private network such as Tailscale when you are away. Nothing goes through our servers, because there are none.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See at a glance what needs you, what is running, and what finished, grouped by day.
• Read the agent's work like a document: Markdown, code blocks, tables, and tool calls folded into one quiet line.
• Send a message, stop a running turn, or start a new session in a folder you choose.
• Catch up after a dropped connection. Zode replays what you missed.
• Light and dark appearance that follows your phone.

NO MAC HANDY?
Tap "Try the demo" on the first screen to explore the whole app with sample data. No account or network needed.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Pairing uses a one-time code, and your phone keeps its own revocable token in the secure store.

Zode is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Z.AI or Anthropic. ZCode and Claude Code are trademarks of their respective owners.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release. Pair your Mac, follow your sessions, read the agent's work, and start new sessions. Includes a demo mode with sample data.

zh-Hans.title: Zode for ZCode
zh-Hans.subtitle: ZCode 的手机伴侣
zh-Hans.promoText: 在手机上用 ZCode。Zode 通过免费中继连接你 Mac 上的 ZCode：跟进会话、阅读工作、新建会话。
zh-Hans.description:
Zode 是 ZCode（AI 编程应用）的手机伴侣应用，让你在手机上跟进和控制 ZCode 的编程会话。Mac 仍是主机：它运行 ZCode，并运行一个免费的小型中继，把你的手机桥接到 ZCode。

你需要准备
1. 一台装有 ZCode 的 Mac。
2. 在同一台 Mac 上运行免费开源的 Zode 中继（一条命令即可安装：https://github.com/zrll2/zode）。
3. 手机上的这个应用。

连接方式
手机  ->  你 Mac 上的 Zode 中继  ->  ZCode
首次使用，扫描中继在 Mac 上显示的二维码即可配对。之后 Zode 通过家里的网络连接你的 Mac；外出时可通过 Tailscale 等私有网络连回。内容不经过任何服务器（我们没有服务器）。

你可以做什么
• 一眼看清需要你处理的、正在运行的和已完成的会话，按日期分组。
• 像读文档一样读 Agent 的工作：支持 Markdown、代码块、表格，工具调用折叠成安静的一行。
• 发消息、停止正在运行的回合，或在你选的文件夹里新建会话。
• 网络断开后自动补发错过的内容。
• 浅色和深色外观，跟随系统。

手边没有 Mac？
在首屏点 "Try the demo"，用示例数据体验完整应用，无需账号和网络。

隐私优先
• 无账号、无广告、无统计、无追踪。
• 一次性配对码；手机的令牌保存在系统安全存储中，可随时撤销。

Zode 是独立项目，与 Z.AI、Anthropic 无隶属、认可或赞助关系。ZCode 和 Claude Code 是各自所有者的商标。
zh-Hans.releaseNotes: 首个版本。配对你的 Mac，跟进会话，阅读 Agent 的工作，新建会话。内置示例数据的演示模式。

review.notes: Zode is a companion app for a Mac. It talks to an open-source relay that runs on the user's own Mac, so a reviewer normally cannot reach one. To review the full app without a Mac: open the app and tap "Try the demo" on the first screen. Demo mode uses built-in sample data and needs no account, login or network. Sessions list, chat, markdown, tool rows, the composer and light/dark appearance can all be reviewed there. The camera is used only to scan the pairing QR code that the relay prints on the user's Mac. The local network permission is requested when the app connects to the user's Mac (an IP address or .local name). The app does not use ATS exceptions beyond NSAllowsLocalNetworking, collects no data, and has no accounts or in-app purchases.
